brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a large-scale raid on the town of Yamun, west of Jenin, overnight, according to Shehab Wire. The operation deployed substantial military reinforcements across the town in what local sources described as an extensive campaign of home searches and arrests.

The raid targeted a number of young men in the Palestinian town. Forces systematically searched dozens of residences as part of the overnight incursion, which witnesses said involved coordinated arrest operations across multiple neighborhoods in the area west of the Jenin governorate.
